name: feedbakkr-watch-sdk
description: The SDKs for FeedBakkr Watch: free error tracking on your own Cloudflare account.

scripts.verify: biome check . && pnpm build && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r test

scripts.security:scan:full: pnpm run security:audit:moderate && pnpm run security:osv
